questions.stem: Which of the following best describes a sequence?
choices: A group of numbers that follows a specific rule
A list of numbers in random order
A set of numbers that only increases
A collection of numbers with no pattern
questions.solution: A sequence is defined as an ordered list of numbers where each number is a term of the sequence. This matches the first option. The second option is incorrect because sequences follow a specific rule. The third and fourth options are incorrect because sequences can increase, decrease, or remain constant, and they can have any pattern, not just increasing ones.

questions.stem: Which type of sequence is defined by multiplying each term by a constant to get the next term?
questions.solution: A geometric progression (GP) is a sequence where each term is obtained by multiplying the previous term by a constant ratio. This is different from an arithmetic progression, where each term is obtained by adding a constant difference. A harmonic progression involves reciprocals of an arithmetic progression, and the Fibonacci sequence is defined by adding the two previous terms.

hi.stem: कौन सा अनुक्रम उस अनुक्रम को परिभाषित करता है जिसमें प्रत्येक पद को अगले पद के प्राप्त करने के लिए एक नियतांक द्वारा गुणा किया जाता है?
hi.solution: ज्यामितीय प्रगति (GP) एक अनुक्रम है जिसमें प्रत्येक पद पिछले पद को एक नियत अनुपात द्वारा गुणा करके प्राप्त किया जाता है। यह अंकगणितीय प्रगति से भिन्न है, जिसमें प्रत्येक पद एक नियत अंतर जोड़कर प्राप्त किया जाता है। हार्मोनिक प्रगति में अंकगणितीय प्रगति के व्युत्क्रम होते हैं, और फिबोनाकी अनुक्रम में दो पिछले पदों को जोड़कर परिभाषित किया जाता है।

questions.stem: Which term of the AP: 21, 42, 63, 84 ... is 210?
questions.solution: The common difference is 21. To find the term number, divide 210 by 21. This gives 10. So, 210 is the 10th term. The first option is incorrect because 21 × 8 = 168. The second option is incorrect because 21 × 9 = 189. The third option is correct because 21 × 10 = 210. The fourth option is incorrect because 21 × 11 = 231.

questions.stem: If the 10th term of an AP is p + 9q, what is the first term of the AP?
questions.solution: The 10th term of an AP is given by a + 9d. If the 10th term is p + 9q, then the first term is p - 9q, assuming d = q. The other options are incorrect rearrangements of the formula.

questions.stem: A sequence is defined by t = 3n + 2. Which of the following best describes this sequence?
questions.solution: The sequence t = 3n + 2 is an arithmetic progression because each term increases by a constant difference of 3. A geometric progression would involve a constant ratio between terms, which is not the case here. A harmonic progression involves reciprocals of an arithmetic sequence, which also does not apply.
